name: Hurting for Clues | Chapter 2 Starter Guide
description_md:
Hurting for Clues

>This series provides 10 playtested decks using the Chapter 2 Core and new Starters, with each deck compatible for two player with at least 7 others (and working well at high player counts). Here Daniela uses [Stalk Prey](/card/60567) to spawn enemies, [Lesson Learned](/card/12022) and [Detective Sherman](/card/60177) to exploit those enemies for clues, and then [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074) to recycle events. Oh, and she also still [Sledgehammers](/card/12028) bad guys into meaty paste (yes I did use "sledgehammer" as a verb...). `If you want to support my work, give it a like ❤︎ and a favorite ★ on here!`

Series Decks

|   Mystic   |   Rogue   |   Guardian   |   Survivor   |   Seeker   | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | Marie | André | Tommy| Miguel | Carolyn | | Dexter | Trish | Daniela | Izzie | Joe |

At a Glance

>| Stats | | >|:---|:---| >| Clue-finding: |  ★★★☆☆ | >| Consistency: |  ★★★★☆ | >| Enemy Management: |  ★★★★★ | >| Encounter Defense: |  ★★★★☆ | >| Survivability: |  ★★★★★ | >| Simplicity: |  ★★★☆☆ |

Overview

- The Sherman tank: This deck is designed to incentivize dealing with enemies. [Stalk Prey](/card/60567) is used to spawn an enemy in and get a clue and a card for doing so (definitely a target for your opening hand), then if you draw a card with an enemy engaged (provoking an AoO) you get more clues with tanky [Detective Sherman](/card/60177) and [Lesson Learned](/card/12022). You can then punish this AoO with your ability using [Sledgehammer](/card/12028), even using the ability if you so choose - which comes in at a 9 test with Sherman. [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074) gives further benefit from bad guys, recurring events such as Lesson Learned and Stalk Prey, or resource economy like [Emergency Cache](/card/12089). - That survival instinct: Daniela makes a lot of use out of her survival pool, using [Same Old Thing](/card/60561) to discount events, [Extra Rations](/card/60570) for healing, and then [Do-or-Die](/card/60568) for added recursion of assets or events. All of this gives a nice contrast to true blue Tommy! - Super soaker: [Detective Sherman](/card/60177) (and before Sherman, [Rookie Cop](/card/60157)) provide horror soak, with one copy of [Canteen](/card/60573) meaning you're not reliant on Sherman alone to keep sane. [Extra Rations](/card/60570) keep Sherman healthy and makes [In Harm's Way](/card/12003) almost harmless. Sherman or Rookie Cop can soak for other investigators, letting you tank AoOs aimed at them to punish with a attack. In addition to enemy attacks, if you soak damage from treacheries with Sherman this also can provide a clue. - Consistency: There's a 93% chance of drawing either a weapon or [Right Tool for the Job](/card/12023) in a hard mulligan. This is reasonable consistency, especially with further card draw from [Overpower](/card/12092) and [Stalk Prey](/card/60567), and from drawing a card with an enemy engaged to punish with your ability. For clue finding consistency, ["Make 'em sing"](/card/60160) helps support. - Encounter deck: The saving grace of this deck is [Scrape By](/card/12082) which allows Daniela to pass any test should she need to. Being able to recur this with [Do-or-Die](/card/60568) adds robustness. While other encounter options are a little thin on the ground, having one which is very strong convinced me to provide a 4 ★ encounter defense rating. Thank you: [5argon](https://arkhamdb.com/user/profile/61394/5argon) and [their thumbnail tool](https://arkham-starter.com/tool/thumbnails); [Valentin1331](https://arkhamdb.com/user/profile/42890/Valentin1331) for his support over the years; the community creators of [Arkham.Build](https://www.patreon.com/c/arkhambuild/) ([Felix](https://spoettel.dev/)), [Arkham Cards](https://www.patreon.com/c/arkhamcards/) ([zzorba](https://www.reddit.com/user/zzorba/)) and [ArkhamDB](https://www.patreon.com/c/kamalisk/) ([kamalisk](https://www.reddit.com/user/kamalisk/)) - linking their Patreons!

Campaign starter and planned progression

If not playing with Tommy, you can replace an [Overpower](/card/12092) with a second copy of [Right Tool for the Job](/card/12023) if you choose. 0 XP deck is below (and link here): A recommended order of purchases/upgrades is: - [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094) → [Scrape By](/card/12082) - 1 x [Machete](/card/12020) → 1 x [Sledgehammer](/card/12028) - 1 x [Rookie Cop](/card/60157) → 1 x [Detective Sherman](/card/60177) - 1 x [Guts](/card/12090) → 1 x [Canteen](/card/60573) - 1 x [Machete](/card/12020) → 1 x [Sledgehammer](/card/12028) - 1 x [Rookie Cop](/card/60157) → 1 x [Detective Sherman](/card/60177) - [Bandages](/card/12073) → [Extra Rations](/card/60570) Post-19 XP suggestions are: - [Overpower](/card/12092) → [Indomitable](/card/60180) - [Vicious Blow](/card/12025) → [Vicious Blow ••](/card/60176)

Explain Yourself!

The new starter decks added some really interesting event support for Daniela (including card draw and clues from [Stalk Prey](/card/60567)), with more clue support from allies as well. I wanted to capitalize on these events and also use recursion tech such as [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074). Clue tech really rounds Daniela off nicely, as she hits hard already for me there's a sense of diminishing returns in more damage capability. In terms of what's missing, there's [Bounty](/card/60161) - but with [Same Old Thing](/card/60561) and [Emergency Cache](/card/12089) (which you can recur) you're wealthy enough (no [Logan](/card/12018) on a similar train of thought). If you're not also running Tommy, you could run a second copy of [Right Tool for the Job](/card/12023), but equally it's not going to transform the deck. [Scene of the Crime](/card/12024) is alright, but I like all the other clue options - e.g. ["Make 'em sing"](/card/60160) - even more. While you could say 8 suitable events is low for [Hunter's Instinct](/card/12074), in practice I think this works - especially as you can loop a single event over and over.

Compatability Matrix

Everyone likes a good matrix! Below are all the decks that are compatible at two player using one Chapter 2 Core and one 2026 Starter Deck set: For higher player counts I've not 'compatabilized' the basic skills ([Overpower](/card/12092), [Manual Dexterity](/card/12091), [Guts](/card/12090), [Perception](/card/12093) and [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094)). There are only 4 copies of each in the Chapter 2 core, enough for any two decks. If playing 3+ players and there's a clash, you can either: - Swap with an appropriate level 0 class skill which that deck can use (e.g. [On the Brink](/card/60569) for [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094)). - Swap with a class event or asset with matching or similar symbols (e.g. [Working a Hunch](/card/12038) for [Perception](/card/12093)). - Swap with a different underused basic skill you still believe would be useful for the deck (e.g. [Guts](/card/12090) for [Unexpected Courage](/card/12094)). - Proxy however you see fit (especially if you own Chapter 1 cards, just use the old school versions and remember the slight difference around who draws the card). I empower you to do sensible things!

Final thoughts

We've already seen big damage Daniela, so this deck tries something new. I tested this deck on Hard difficulty, and with the [Sledgehammer](/card/12028) big boost and auto-clues it performed quite well. As it stands, Guardian with Survivor splash is the only way to run both [Stalk Prey](/card/60567) and together with all the blue enemy clue tech ([Lesson Learned](/card/12022), ["Make 'em sing"](/card/60160), [Detective Sherman](/card/60177)). This gives Daniela wild-eyed, hammer-wielding hunter vibes, which is neat and a nice change of pace from Tommy. Any thoughts - drop them below!
